mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (title, description, status, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, user_id, role, is_approved) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{isApproved})
mapper.select: SELECT pm.project_id, pm.user_id, pm.role, pm.is_approved AS isApproved, u.name AS userName FROM project_members pm JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT pm.project_id, pm.user_id, pm.role, pm.is_approved AS isApproved, u.name AS userName FROM project_members pm JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_members WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_tasks (project_id, title, description, start_date, due_date, assigned_to, status, priority, color, created_by) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{assignedTo}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{color}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT pt.* FROM project_tasks pt WHERE pt.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pt.created_at

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.status, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, pm.role FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON p.id = pm.project_id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_approved = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_reports (project_id, title, description, file_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, title, description, file_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded_by, uploaded_at FROM project_reports WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
